tools.name: photo_relief
tools.description: Turn a photo into a relief made for the printer it will print on.

style.title: Style
style.description: The relief style: ``auto``, ``coin``, ``cameo``, ``etched`` or ``sketch``; the reply lists the accepted names when the one given is not a relief style.

canvas_mm.title: Canvas Mm
canvas_mm.description: The relief's width on the part, in mm.

depth_mm.title: Depth Mm
depth_mm.description: Relief depth in mm (1.2-2.0 reads well).

layer_mm.title: Layer Mm
layer_mm.description: The layer height the print will use; left out, 0.20 mm and the reply says so.

nozzle_mm.title: Nozzle Mm
nozzle_mm.description: Nozzle size; left out, the nozzle Kiln knows of, and the reply says which.

tools.name: resume_interrupted_print
tools.description: Resume an interrupted print with one call on any supported FDM printer (Pro).

original_gcode_path.title: Original Gcode Path
original_gcode_path.description: Path to the ORIGINAL (pre-pause) PrusaSlicer gcode. Required — kiln can't infer this from the printer's reported filename alone because Bambu only exposes the 3MF name (the source gcode may live in a slicer profile temp dir the agent knows and the printer doesn't).

layer.title: Layer
layer.description: The layer to resume FROM. Default 0 → auto-resolve from ``printer_status.job.current_layer``. Pass explicitly if the printer was power-cycled and current_layer is stale.

printer_name.title: Printer Name
printer_name.description: Which printer. Default empty → active printer.

prime_extrusion_mm.title: Prime Extrusion Mm
prime_extrusion_mm.description: Extruder purge length in mm at the safe Z-lift position, default 5.0. It re-pressurizes the hotend after the cancel-to-start transition, which would otherwise leave the extruder retracted and printing air. Set lower only when the melt is known intact; set 0 only when you have primed another way.

material_type.title: Material Type
material_type.description: Sets the overlap layers in the resume file Kiln builds. Default ``"PLA"``.

use_ams.title: Use Ams
use_ams.description: Bambu-only. Tri-state routing for the resumed print's filament source (``"auto"`` / ``"true"`` / ``"false"``). Default ``"auto"`` — inspects the current AMS state and picks the tray that's actively loaded (``tray_now``); falls back to external spool when nothing is loaded. Ignored on non-Bambu adapters. Pass ``"false"`` to feed from the external spool regardless of AMS state.

ams_mapping.title: Ams Mapping
ams_mapping.description: Bambu-only. Explicit AMS slot mapping per extruder (e.g. ``[2]`` = pull from tray 2). Default ``None`` — lets ``start_print`` auto-resolve from AMS state or 3MF plate metadata. Ignored on non-Bambu adapters.

target_ams_slot.title: Target Ams Slot
target_ams_slot.description: Optional 0-indexed AMS slot to force for a material-changing resume. When supplied, Kiln emits the same slot into the resume preamble and the ``start_print`` call.

target_filament_type.title: Target Filament Type
target_filament_type.description: Optional expected tray material. Without ``target_ams_slot``, Kiln resolves exactly one matching loaded tray from AMS status or fails closed.

target_filament_color.title: Target Filament Color
target_filament_color.description: Optional expected tray color (hex or common name). Used with the same hard verification as ``target_filament_type``.

require_ams_match.title: Require Ams Match
require_ams_match.description: True (the default) refuses the resume when AMS status cannot prove the requested filament route; False proceeds on the caller's word.

manual_material_change_confirmed.title: Manual Material Change Confirmed
manual_material_change_confirmed.description: Non-Bambu safety gate for requested material/color changes. Set True only after a human/operator has loaded the target material into the active feed path; otherwise Kiln refuses before canceling or uploading anything.

tools.name: batch_estimate_plate_part_costs
tools.description: Batch-estimate per-part economics for many sliced plates (Business).

items.title: Items
items.description: The plates to estimate, a non-empty list of dicts in the shape above; the list length is capped.  An item that is not a dict, or has no ``file_path``, is reported as an error and skipped.

material.title: Material
material.description: The default material for every item that does not name its own; defaults to ``PLA``.

cost_per_kg_usd.title: Cost Per Kg Usd
cost_per_kg_usd.description: The default filament price in US dollars per kilogram for every item that does not name its own. Omitted, Kiln's built-in price for the material is used; must not be negative.

electricity_rate.title: Electricity Rate
electricity_rate.description: The default electricity price in US dollars per kWh for every item, 0.12 unless set; must not be negative.

printer_wattage.title: Printer Wattage
printer_wattage.description: The default average power draw in watts for every item, 200 unless set; must not be negative.

tools.name: estimate_plate_part_costs
tools.description: Estimate per-part print time, filament, and cost for a sliced plate (Business).

file_path.title: File Path
file_path.description: Path to the sliced ``.gcode.3mf`` plate file.  A missing file answers ``FILE_NOT_FOUND``; a file that is not a ZIP/3MF answers ``INVALID_INPUT``.

plate_number.title: Plate Number
plate_number.description: Which plate in the file to read, counted from 1; defaults to the first.

material.title: Material
material.description: The material name used to price every object not named in ``material_by_object``; defaults to ``PLA``.

material_by_object.title: Material By Object
material_by_object.description: Optional map from an object name, object stem or label ID string to the material that object prints in.

cost_per_kg_usd.title: Cost Per Kg Usd
cost_per_kg_usd.description: Filament price in US dollars per kilogram. Omitted, Kiln's built-in price for the material is used; must not be negative.

electricity_rate.title: Electricity Rate
electricity_rate.description: Electricity price in US dollars per kWh, defaults to 0.12; must not be negative.

printer_wattage.title: Printer Wattage
printer_wattage.description: The printer's average power draw in watts, defaults to 200; must not be negative.

tools.name: print_cost_intelligence
tools.description: What a print's filament changes cost and how to cut them, and the cost with a reprint priced in.

gcode_gz_b64.title: Gcode Gz B64
gcode_gz_b64.description: The G-code, gzip-compressed then base64 (what a served caller sends).

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The file's name, for the answer.

filaments.title: Filaments
filaments.description: Public Kiln's per-filament entries for the same file (``tool``, ``material``, ``weight_g``, ``length_m``, ``cost_usd``), so the breakdown is priced exactly as the total was.

total_cost_usd.title: Total Cost Usd
total_cost_usd.description: The estimate's total, for the risk-adjusted figure.

printer_id.title: Printer Id
printer_id.description: The printer the print is for.

annotations.title: Cost intelligence for a print file

tools.name: abrasive_escalation
tools.description: Pro+ — escalates the abrasive-filament warning by nozzle.

material.title: Material
material.description: The filament about to print (``"PLA-CF"``, ``"PETG-GF"``).  Empty is refused with ``VALIDATION_ERROR``.

printer_id.title: Printer Id
printer_id.description: Stable printer identifier whose recorded nozzle is judged.  Empty is refused; a printer with no nozzle on record is judged with its nozzle material unknown.

tools.name: add_feature_during_print
tools.description: Add a new shape to a paused print, then finish the print with it (Pro). Opens Kiln's interactive inline 3D stage on the result (orbit/zoom panel in MCP Apps hosts; hosted sessions add a browser stage link).

feature.title: Feature
feature.description: Normie spec ("a small top hat", "/path/to/hat.stl", "library:halo_v2", etc.).

gcode_path.title: Gcode Path
gcode_path.description: Original sliced .gcode of the in-flight job.

current_layer.title: Current Layer
current_layer.description: 1-indexed layer the printer is paused at.

pause_z_mm.title: Pause Z Mm
pause_z_mm.description: Physical Z of the pause point in mm. REQUIRED if the source gcode's layer markers don't carry Z comments; the engine will error with ``FEATURE_PAUSE_Z_UNKNOWN`` in that case if this is left ``None``.

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: ``[x, y]`` bed coords where the feature's XY centroid lands.  ``None`` = resolved bed centre.

first_layer_height_mm.title: First Layer Height Mm
first_layer_height_mm.description: First-layer height of the sliced feature — the slicer rests this on top of the paused print's top face.

hotend_temp.title: Hotend Temp
hotend_temp.description: Nozzle temperature for the feature slice, the resume pre-heat and Bambu 3MF metadata.  Leave unset to use the print's own (read off ``gcode_path`` at the pause). A value that differs from the print's own is kept and said in ``warnings``.

bed_temp.title: Bed Temp
bed_temp.description: Bed temperature for the same three, read and checked the same way.  The feature slice heats the bed itself, so this is the bed the rest of the print runs at.

filament_type.title: Filament Type
filament_type.description: The print's material, for Bambu 3MF metadata and material-routing provenance.  Leave it out and Kiln reads the print's own material; when nothing says which, the call is refused (``PRINT_MATERIAL_UNKNOWN``).

printer_bed_size.title: Printer Bed Size
printer_bed_size.description: Explicit ``[x, y]`` in mm.  If omitted, Kiln resolves ``printer_name`` through bundled printer intelligence and fails closed when the bed size is unknown.

slicer_config_ini.title: Slicer Config Ini
slicer_config_ini.description: Path to a prusaslicer .ini. Empty = use the slicer's default / installed profile discovered by the auto-discovery.

parent_design_id.title: Parent Design Id
parent_design_id.description: Optional design this print derives from, recorded in the session's provenance.

target_ams_slot.title: Target Ams Slot
target_ams_slot.description: Optional 0-indexed AMS slot that must feed the injected feature. ``-1`` means no explicit material route was requested.

target_filament_type.title: Target Filament Type
target_filament_type.description: Optional expected tray material. Without an explicit slot, Kiln resolves exactly one matching loaded AMS tray from ``ams_status`` or fails closed.

target_filament_color.title: Target Filament Color
target_filament_color.description: Optional expected tray color (``#RRGGBB`` or a common name like ``blue``).

require_ams_match.title: Require Ams Match
require_ams_match.description: When True, refuse to emit the feature resume unless AMS status proves the requested material route.

manual_material_change_confirmed.title: Manual Material Change Confirmed
manual_material_change_confirmed.description: Non-Bambu safety gate for material/color changes. Set True only after the target material is loaded in the active feed path; otherwise Kiln refuses before emitting an artifact.

annotations.title: Add a feature during a print

tools.name: add_pin_joints
tools.description:
Give two touching parts a REAL pin-and-socket joint. Opens Kiln's interactive inline 3D stage on the result (orbit/zoom panel in MCP Apps hosts; hosted sessions add a browser stage link).

Needs Kiln Pro.

part_a_path.title: Part A Path
part_a_path.description: The part that GROWS the pin.

part_b_path.title: Part B Path
part_b_path.description: The part that receives the socket.

output_dir.title: Output Dir
output_dir.description: Where the two new STLs land (default temp).

pin_diameter_mm.title: Pin Diameter Mm
pin_diameter_mm.description: Override the derived diameter in mm (0 = derive from the contact patch).  Values outside the printable pin range are clamped and the result says so.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Output scale — the joint derives AFTER scaling.

material.title: Material
material.description: Filament the parts print in — sets the rating basis (default PLA).

application_class.title: Application Class
application_class.description: How much margin the rating demands, least to most: prototype, internal_fixture, consumer_product, outdoor_hardware, life_safety, lifting_equipment.  Any other value is refused.

design_id.title: Design Id
design_id.description: Optional design to track this under — both modified parts are registered as versions so the original and the jointed variants share history.

tools.name: advise_kit_scale
tools.description: Find the largest scale at which EVERY part of a kit prints.

part_paths.title: Part Paths
part_paths.description: One mesh file per part (the import_model_parts output).

nozzle_mm.title: Nozzle Mm
nozzle_mm.description: Nozzle diameter — sets the feature floor. Leave unset for the only printer Kiln knows of, else 0.4; ``nozzle`` in the reply says which.

tools.name: analyze_mid_print_impact
tools.description: Pre-commit truth gate: which layers will actually change (Pro).

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Session key from a prior ``decorate_during_print`` / ``add_feature_during_print`` call.  Resolved under ~/.kiln/mid_print_sessions/ and the legacy tempdir fallbacks that ``get_print_before_edit`` uses.

engine_output_dir.title: Engine Output Dir
engine_output_dir.description: Direct path to the session directory.  Higher priority if both supplied.

carved_gcode_path.title: Carved Gcode Path
carved_gcode_path.description: Explicit path to a carved gcode, bypassing session lookup entirely.  Useful for analysing a carved artifact that isn't in a standard session directory.

requested_depth_mm.title: Requested Depth Mm
requested_depth_mm.description: The decoration depth the originating tool call asked for.  Used to compute the ``depth_gap_mm`` and fire ``DEPTH_SHY`` when the achievable depth falls short.  Pass 0.0 (default) to skip depth warnings — the per-layer breakdown + carve metrics still populate.

tools.name: answer_printer_question
tools.description: Answer one question about one printer: a hardware fact, whether it protects against thermal runaway, or which screw goes where when you take an assembly apart.

printer_id.title: Printer Id
printer_id.description: A printer model id such as ``bambu_a1`` or ``ender3``, or the name a printer is registered under (``default``) for a live reading.

tools.name: apply_mid_print_decoration_plan
tools.description: Commit a planned mid-print decoration (Pro). Opens Kiln's interactive inline 3D stage on the result (orbit/zoom panel in MCP Apps hosts; hosted sessions add a browser stage link).

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: The ``session_id`` that ``plan_mid_print_decoration`` returned. One of this or ``engine_output_dir`` is required.

engine_output_dir.title: Engine Output Dir
engine_output_dir.description: The plan's ``engine_output_dir``; when given and it exists it wins over ``session_id``.

tools.name: auto_detect_nozzle
tools.description: Parse a raw printer payload into a NozzleState.

printer_id.title: Printer Id
printer_id.description: Stable printer identifier this nozzle state belongs to.

raw_payload.title: Raw Payload
raw_payload.description: The raw text or JSON the LAN fetch returned.

annotations.title: Detect a nozzle and refresh its saved record

tools.name: auto_recover
tools.description:
Recover a failed print in one guided operation.

Needs Kiln Pro.

printer_name.title: Printer Name
printer_name.description: Printer to recover on, as the computer attached to it names it.

telemetry.title: Telemetry
telemetry.description: What you know about the print now, beside the reading the computer takes (``spaghetti_detected``, ``filament_detected``, ...).  Where the two name the same thing and differ, the reading wins and the difference is said.

telemetry_history.title: Telemetry History
telemetry_history.description: Earlier readings (each answer's ``observation``), for trend-based detection.

job_info.title: Job Info
job_info.description: Current job metadata; ``material`` sets how a resume file is built.  A path in it is not opened.

failure_id.title: Failure Id
failure_id.description: Not read: each call judges a fresh reading. A call that passes one is told so.

alternative_printers.title: Alternative Printers
alternative_printers.description: Narrows which of your other printers may take the job when ``retry_mode`` moves it; those printers are read on the computer attached to them.

auto_confirm.title: Auto Confirm
auto_confirm.description: Does nothing: an action runs only when ``run_actions`` hands back the digest of the list shown. Kept so older calls still parse.

retry_mode.title: Retry Mode
retry_mode.description: ``"off"`` (default) | ``"same_bed"`` | ``"fleet"`` | ``"auto"`` (``"auto"`` tries the same bed first, then another of your printers).  Moving the job to another printer needs the fleet plan; the refusal names it.

vision_strictness.title: Vision Strictness
vision_strictness.description: ``"advisory"`` (default) | ``"strict"``.  Advisory reports what a brought picture shows without stopping on it; strict pauses on a sharp change.

monitoring_interval_s.title: Monitoring Interval S
monitoring_interval_s.description: Seconds until the next reading is worth taking (``next_check_s``).  Default 30s.

monitoring_max_wall_s.title: Monitoring Max Wall S
monitoring_max_wall_s.description: Not read: each call is one reading, and how long to keep polling is yours to decide.  Kept so older calls still parse.

plate_objects.title: Plate Objects
plate_objects.description: The ``objects`` list from ``list_plate_objects`` (each with ``label_id``, ``name``, ``bbox``, ``area_mm2``), for the skip-failed-objects path. Without it, a ``.gcode.3mf`` passed as ``gcode_path`` is read for them (``job_info["plate_number"]`` picks the plate).

failed_objects.title: Failed Objects
failed_objects.description: Which plate object(s) failed, by ``label_id`` or name (same matching as ``plan_object_skip``).  Used only when ``allow_skip_failed_objects`` is True.

allow_skip_failed_objects.title: Allow Skip Failed Objects
allow_skip_failed_objects.description: Off by default. When True and the plate localizes to specific failed object(s) on a printer with known skip capability, proposes skipping just those objects instead of the standard abort/retry path.

gcode_path.title: Gcode Path
gcode_path.description: The sliced file that is printing: what a resume file is built from (a paused print resumed where it stopped) or what is started on another printer when ``retry_mode`` moves the job.  Through Kiln's servers it is sent with the call.

snapshot_path.title: Snapshot Path
snapshot_path.description: A picture of the print now (from ``printer_snapshot``), judged with ``vision_strictness``. Without one the answer says the verdict was reached without looking.

baseline_snapshot_path.title: Baseline Snapshot Path
baseline_snapshot_path.description: An earlier picture of the same print, so ``snapshot_path`` can show a change.

part_attached.title: Part Attached
part_attached.description: Your word on whether the half-printed part is still stuck to the plate (``true``) or gone (``false``), when no picture settles it. Omitted, the answer asks once before a resume is offered.

try_untested_resume.title: Try Untested Resume
try_untested_resume.description: Opt this printer in to a Kiln-built resume on a model Kiln has not yet seen one work on. Defaults to ``False``, which leaves the resume unoffered there.

tools.name: check_assembly_stands
tools.description: Judge how an object LIVES and whether it STANDS — from geometry and the words, with every assumption said out loud.

part_paths.title: Part Paths
part_paths.description: One mesh file per part, positioned as assembled.

pin_recipes.title: Pin Recipes
pin_recipes.description: Optional add_pin_joints recipes (each carrying a ``parts: [a, b]`` key naming its pair) — the pin's normal then replaces the inferred seam direction.

gravity.title: Gravity
gravity.description: Direction gravity acts, as ``[x, y, z]`` (default straight down, ``[0, 0, -1]``) — tilt it to judge an object displayed on its side.

materials.title: Materials
materials.description: The parts' filaments — one name for the whole kit, or a list aligned with ``part_paths``.  Named, every part gets grams at its catalogue density and the centre of mass is weighted by mass (a PETG body on TPU feet is judged as that); unnamed, density is uniform and the report says so.

pose.title: Pose
pose.description: ``"auto"`` (default) decides how it lives and lists the other resting faces; ``"as_placed"`` judges only the authored orientation under ``gravity``.

intent.title: Intent
intent.description: The idea in the user's own words — the brief's text ("a wall hook for my coat").

product_type.title: Product Type
product_type.description: The Kiln generator that made it (``"pen_cup"``, ``"ornament"``).

template_id.title: Template Id
template_id.description: The design template it came from.

lives_as.title: Lives As
lives_as.description: The mode the user chose, when asked: sits on a surface / lies flat on a surface / mounts to a wall or another surface / hangs from a loop or hole / is held, worn or carried / fits into or onto something else.

part_names.title: Part Names
part_names.description: Names aligned with ``part_paths`` when two files share a stem.

design_id.title: Design Id
design_id.description: The design these parts belong to.  A design a Kiln generator made carries its product in its id (``"keychain-…"``), so the generator's own answer to how it lives is read from there when ``product_type`` is not given.

carried_mass_g.title: Carried Mass G
carried_mass_g.description: What it will HOLD — the coat on the hook, the water in the vase, the charm on the pendant — in grams. Needs ``materials`` (the object's own mass must be in grams too).  It moves the centre of mass, so the tip angle, the hang and the fastener loads all answer for the loaded object.

carried_at_mm.title: Carried At Mm
carried_at_mm.description: Where that load acts, ``[x, y, z]``; default the hook's tip / the pendant's lowest point / the top.

tools.name: check_nozzle_capacity_for_print
tools.description: Pre-print check — will the nozzle survive this print's wear cost?

printer_id.title: Printer Id
printer_id.description: Active printer identifier.

planned_grams.title: Planned Grams
planned_grams.description: Estimated filament weight for the upcoming print, in grams.

filament_material.title: Filament Material
filament_material.description: The filament being printed (``"PETG-CF"``, ``"Wood-PLA"``, ``"PLA"``); it decides whether the print counts as abrasive.  Omitted, the answer assumes a non-abrasive filament and says it was not told, so pass it.

printer_model.title: Printer Model
printer_model.description: Optional model lookup key for the factory-default fallback when the printer has no recorded state.

tools.name: check_power_loss_recovery
tools.description: Assess how to recover an interrupted print after a power loss (Pro).

printer_name.title: Printer Name
printer_name.description: Registered printer to assess.  Empty = your only registered printer; with several, pass a name.

probe_xy.title: Probe Xy
probe_xy.description: ``[x, y]`` of a confirmed-bare patch of bed, in machine coordinates.  Omit for an assessment-only call.

bare_confirmed.title: Bare Confirmed
bare_confirmed.description: Must be True (with ``probe_xy``) to get a contract — your attestation the patch is physically empty.

print_bbox.title: Print Bbox
print_bbox.description: Optional declared part bbox for a fast pre-check; the resume generator derives the real footprint from the G-code regardless, so this is rarely needed.

moonraker_config.title: Moonraker Config
moonraker_config.description: Optional pre-fetched ``configfile.config`` dict (``GET /printer/objects/query?configfile``).  Supply it when the server can't reach the printer's Moonraker directly (e.g. the hosted API) — the client fetches, the server plans.

failure_id.title: Failure Id
failure_id.description: Optional recorded print failure whose original G-code Kiln looks up, so the Klipper probe path can suggest a bare spot. Ignored when ``gcode_path`` is given; an unknown id simply skips the suggestion.

gcode_path.title: Gcode Path
gcode_path.description: Optional path to the interrupted print's G-code, used the same way and taking precedence over ``failure_id``.

probe_clearance_mm.title: Probe Clearance Mm
probe_clearance_mm.description: Min margin the probe must clear the print by.

tools.name: cutter_wear_status
tools.description: How worn is this machine's filament-cutter blade, against the maker's own number.

printer_id.title: Printer Id
printer_id.description: The registered printer's name, the id its blade record is kept under.  Empty is refused with ``VALIDATION_ERROR``.

printer_model.title: Printer Model
printer_model.description: The printer's catalogue model, which picks the maker's replacement number.  Empty, Kiln uses the model this install's config declares (never on the hosted server), else the one on the blade record.

recent_faults.title: Recent Faults
recent_faults.description: The machine's recent cutter fault codes, a list of ``{"code", "at"}`` dicts, filled in by the caller's own Kiln from its event log.  Omitted, Kiln reads its local event log (nothing on the hosted server).

tools.name: deboss_during_print
tools.description: Carve a debossed image into the top of an in-flight print (Pro).

image_path.title: Image Path
image_path.description: PNG/JPG to deboss into the top.

gcode_path.title: Gcode Path
gcode_path.description: Original sliced .gcode of the in-flight job.

current_layer.title: Current Layer
current_layer.description: 1-indexed layer the printer is paused at. The deboss starts at ``current_layer + 1`` so the carve never touches the layer currently being laid down.

depth_mm.title: Depth Mm
depth_mm.description: Deboss depth in mm.  Must be in (0, 5].

top_layers.title: Top Layers
top_layers.description: Reserved override for the top-layer count. ``None`` (default) uses the value detected from ``analyze_top_region`` (TYPE:Top tags or solid-infill inference).

image_scale.title: Image Scale
image_scale.description: Heightmap-to-bed scale factor — 0.7 means the image fills 70% of the carved region's bounding box.

aspect_policy.title: Aspect Policy
aspect_policy.description: How to fit a non-matching aspect ratio onto the carve region.  ``"auto_crop"`` crops the image to match (default), ``"auto_scale"`` letterboxes it, ``"strict"`` rejects mismatches.

printer_z_known.title: Printer Z Known
printer_z_known.description: REQUIRED ``True``.  Same safety gate as ``generate_recovery_gcode`` — if the printer's Z isn't trustworthy, refuses with ``PRINTER_Z_UNKNOWN``.

resume_z_mm.title: Resume Z Mm
resume_z_mm.description: Explicit resume Z height in mm.  ``None`` means the resume scanner derives it from the carved G-code at ``current_layer + 1``.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Heightmap value above which a pixel is treated as carved-away (0.0–1.0, default 0.35).

bevel.title: Bevel
bevel.description: Add a 1-layer bevel ring around the deboss for cleaner visual edges.  Default ``True``.

output_dir.title: Output Dir
output_dir.description: Output directory for the carved + resume files.  ``None`` uses the system temp dir.

package_as_3mf.title: Package As 3Mf
package_as_3mf.description: When ``True`` (default), the tool also wraps the resume gcode as a Bambu resume-mode 3MF and returns its path as ``resume_3mf_path``.  Disable for non-Bambu targets or when you want to inspect the carved gcode before packaging.  On failure the error is surfaced via ``warnings`` — the .gcode path is still returned so the caller can recover.

source_3mf_path.title: Source 3Mf Path
source_3mf_path.description: Passed through to the 3MF wrapper. Supplying the original job's .3mf preserves its thumbnail and 3D model preview on the printer's display.

hotend_temp.title: Hotend Temp
hotend_temp.description: Hotend setpoint for the resume 3MF metadata.  Leave unset to use the temperature the print's own file heats to; a value that differs from it is kept and said in ``warnings``.

bed_temp.title: Bed Temp
bed_temp.description: Bed setpoint for the 3MF metadata, read the same way as ``hotend_temp``.

filament_type.title: Filament Type
filament_type.description: The print's material, for 3MF metadata. Leave it out and Kiln reads the print's own material; when nothing says which, the call is refused (``PRINT_MATERIAL_UNKNOWN``).

tools.name: decorate_during_print
tools.description: Add a decoration to an in-flight paused print (Pro). Opens Kiln's interactive inline 3D stage on the result (orbit/zoom panel in MCP Apps hosts; hosted sessions add a browser stage link).

decoration.title: Decoration
decoration.description: Plain-language spec string (``photo:``, ``logo:``, a texture name, or a description).

gcode_path.title: Gcode Path
gcode_path.description: Original sliced .gcode of the in-flight job.

current_layer.title: Current Layer
current_layer.description: 1-indexed layer the printer is paused at.

printer_name.title: Printer Name
printer_name.description: Printer identifier — passed to provenance and to the fleet layer.

printer_z_known.title: Printer Z Known
printer_z_known.description: REQUIRED ``True``.  The safety gate from ``generate_recovery_gcode`` — refuses with ``PRINTER_Z_UNKNOWN`` if the printer's absolute Z can't be trusted (power-cycle / reconnect / etc.).

depth_mm.title: Depth Mm
depth_mm.description: Deboss depth in mm, (0, 5].  Defaults to 1.2 which looks clean on 0.4 nozzles.

image_scale.title: Image Scale
image_scale.description: 0.0–1.0, what fraction of the top-face AABB the image fills.  Default 0.7 leaves a visual margin.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Heightmap value above which a pixel is treated as carved-away (0.0–1.0, default 0.35).

bevel.title: Bevel
bevel.description: Slant the carved walls over the top N layers for cleaner edges (default True).

aspect_policy.title: Aspect Policy
aspect_policy.description: ``"auto_crop"`` / ``"auto_scale"`` / ``"strict"`` — how to handle aspect mismatch between image and top face.

output_dir.title: Output Dir
output_dir.description: Engine session directory.  Empty = system temp dir (a new ``kiln_midprint_*`` subdirectory).

hotend_temp.title: Hotend Temp
hotend_temp.description: Nozzle temperature for the resume pre-heat and Bambu 3MF metadata.  Leave unset to use the print's own (read off ``gcode_path`` at the pause).  A value that differs from the print's own is kept and said in ``warnings``.

bed_temp.title: Bed Temp
bed_temp.description: Bed temperature, read and checked the same way as ``hotend_temp``.

filament_type.title: Filament Type
filament_type.description: The print's material, for Bambu 3MF metadata and material-routing provenance.  Leave it out and Kiln reads the print's own material; when nothing says which, the call is refused (``PRINT_MATERIAL_UNKNOWN``).

source_3mf_path.title: Source 3Mf Path
source_3mf_path.description: Optional original .3mf — passed to the Bambu wrapper so the resume 3MFs inherit the thumbnails + 3D model preview from the original job.

parent_design_id.title: Parent Design Id
parent_design_id.description: Optional identifier of the design this print is derived from — threads through to the provenance sidecar so reprint/diff tooling can follow the lineage.

image_center_xy.title: Image Center Xy
image_center_xy.description: Optional ``[x, y]`` in bed coords for where the image's center lands.  ``None`` = center of the top-face AABB.

style.title: Style
style.description: How the image becomes a carve mask: ``"stencil"`` (the default, a clean binary silhouette) or ``"coin"`` (a medallion-style recessed background around the image); the other image styles of Kiln's emboss pipeline are accepted too. A style the pipeline refuses fails with ``HEIGHTMAP_GENERATION_FAILED``.

start_layer_override.title: Start Layer Override
start_layer_override.description: Force the carver's first carved layer.  ``0`` (the default) defers to the analyzer's verified ``top_band_start_layer`` floor — the correct choice for any carve whose mask might touch a perimeter.  A non-zero value reaches down to that layer instead, enabling deeper tactile debosses on thin parts whose analyzer floor is overly conservative.  Setting this below the analyzer's band_floor requires ``accept_unsafe_depth=True`` AND a centered carve mask (the analyzer's depth-safety envelope).

accept_unsafe_depth.title: Accept Unsafe Depth
accept_unsafe_depth.description: Caller's acknowledgement that the carve mask satisfies the centered-carve safety envelope (centered interior, uniform top-to-bottom, no lost bridge endpoints).  Required when ``start_layer_override`` is strictly below the analyzer's ``band_floor``.  Without it the engine raises ``DEPTH_UNSAFE_WITHOUT_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT``.

accept_bridge_cascade_risk.title: Accept Bridge Cascade Risk
accept_bridge_cascade_risk.description: THIRD safety gate on top of ``start_layer_override`` + ``accept_unsafe_depth``. Required when the override drops below ``band_floor`` AND any layer in ``[override, last_layer]`` is tagged ``;TYPE:Bridge infill`` or ``;TYPE:Internal infill`` in the source gcode.  Crossing one of those layers removes the substrate the solid infill above was going to cool against, cascading into a cap failure. Without it the engine raises ``BRIDGE_CASCADE_RISK``.

target_ams_slot.title: Target Ams Slot
target_ams_slot.description: Optional 0-indexed material slot that must feed the transformed resume artifact. On Bambu this is verified against AMS status. On non-Bambu adapters it is accepted only as an explicit declared tool slot route, for example when the user says the requested material/color is in slot 2. ``-1`` means no explicit material route was requested.

target_filament_type.title: Target Filament Type
target_filament_type.description: Optional expected tray material (``PLA``, ``PETG``, etc.). Without an explicit slot, the tool resolves exactly one loaded matching AMS tray from Kiln's existing ``ams_status`` data or fails closed.

target_filament_color.title: Target Filament Color
target_filament_color.description: Optional expected tray color (``#RRGGBB`` or common name like ``blue``). Used with the same hard verification as ``target_filament_type``.

require_ams_match.title: Require Ams Match
require_ams_match.description: When True, refuse to emit a material-changing resume artifact unless AMS status proves the requested slot/type/color. Keep True for user-facing work.

manual_material_change_confirmed.title: Manual Material Change Confirmed
manual_material_change_confirmed.description: Non-Bambu safety gate for material/color changes. Set True only after the target material is loaded in the active feed path; otherwise Kiln refuses before emitting an artifact.

printer_z_known.description: REQUIRED.  Pass ``True`` if the printer's absolute Z is trustworthy (same session, no power-cycle since failure).  Pass ``False`` otherwise — the tool will refuse to generate a resume and return ``PRINTER_Z_UNKNOWN`` with guidance to re-calibrate Z first. power_loss_probe_recovery.title: Power Loss Probe Recovery
power_loss_probe_recovery.description: OPT-IN, default ``None``.  After a power-cycle ``printer_z_known=False`` normally refuses; supplying a verified confirmed-bare probe contract instead RE-ESTABLISHES absolute Z by probing a patch of bed proven off-part by the print's XY bounding box, then re-datuming from the measured contact.  Klipper only in v1 (Marlin gated off; Bambu/Prusa defer to built-in recovery).  Required keys: ``enabled``, ``bare_confirmed``, ``firmware``, ``probe_xy``, ``print_bbox``, ``bed_size``, ``probe_is_z_reference``, ``z_assert_safe_mm``, ``probe_z_offset_mm``.  Adds ``PROBE_*`` gate codes; on success the response carries a ``resume_validation`` honesty marker (``software_validated_hardware_unverified`` — this re-datum has not been run on real hardware yet).

telemetry.title: Telemetry
telemetry.description: The current reading, with keys like ``hotend_temp``, ``hotend_target``, ``bed_temp``, ``flow_ratio`` (and ``vibration_rms`` / ``acoustic_band_2k_4k`` where the printer has them).

telemetry_history.title: Telemetry History
telemetry_history.description: Not read.  Kept so older callers keep working; Kiln keeps the print's readings itself.

job_info.title: Job Info
job_info.description: The job: ``job_id`` or ``file_name`` (which print this is), ``layer``, ``layer_times_s``, ``estimated_layer_time_s``.

printer_id.title: Printer Id
printer_id.description: The printer, as the caller names it.  Also consults the recorded nozzle-lifetime state for a bounded ``nozzle_wear`` signal.

band.free: Clear, watch or high risk, 10 prints a day
band.pro: + What is drifting and why, every print

tools.name: preview_decorated_mesh
tools.description: Render a 3D preview of a mid-print decorated part (Pro). Opens Kiln's interactive inline 3D stage on the result (orbit/zoom panel in MCP Apps hosts; hosted sessions add a browser stage link).

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Session key from decorate_during_print. Resolved against the engine's persistent root + legacy tempdir fallbacks.  Provenance sidecar supplies decoration spec + depth if not overridden.

engine_output_dir.title: Engine Output Dir
engine_output_dir.description: Direct path to session dir. Higher priority than session_id.

source_gcode_path.title: Source Gcode Path
source_gcode_path.description: Explicit path to the pre-carve source gcode used to derive the part's XY bounds. When omitted and a session is given, the engine's carved gcode is used (its XY envelope equals the source's — the carver never adds new XY).

decoration.title: Decoration
decoration.description: Override the provenance-derived decoration spec.  v1 supports "kiln"; other specs surface DECORATION_NOT_SUPPORTED with the allow-list.

image_scale.title: Image Scale
image_scale.description: Decoration size as a fraction of the part's shorter top-face axis.  Default 0.6.

output_dir.title: Output Dir
output_dir.description: Directory for the rendered PNGs + decorated STL.  Empty = a fresh kiln_preview_stl_* tempdir.  A named folder must be new or empty (``OUTPUT_EXISTS`` otherwise): the files have fixed names, so an earlier preview there is never written over.

color.title: Color
color.description: Filament colour for the render (hex). Defaults to white.

tools.name: preview_mid_print_session
tools.description: One-call approval gate for a mid-print decoration (Pro). Opens Kiln's interactive inline 3D stage on the result (orbit/zoom panel in MCP Apps hosts; hosted sessions add a browser stage link).

engine_output_dir.title: Engine Output Dir
engine_output_dir.description: Direct path to session.  Higher priority than session_id.

decoration.title: Decoration
decoration.description: Override the provenance-derived decoration spec.  Empty = use the session's.

depth_mm.title: Depth Mm
depth_mm.description: Override the session's requested depth. 0.0 = use the session's (for the layer-impact report's DEPTH_SHY check).

image_scale.title: Image Scale
image_scale.description: Override the session's image_scale. 0.0 (default) = the scale the session was carved with, else 0.6.

regen_thumbnail.title: Regen Thumbnail
regen_thumbnail.description: When True (default), also regenerate the 3MF's embedded thumbnails so the printer screen matches the render.  Set False to skip the thumbnail swap (faster, but Bambu screen will show the undecorated source thumbnail on upload).

tools.name: record_completed_print
tools.description: Record a completed print into the learning system.

printer_id.title: Printer Id
printer_id.description: The printer identifier (e.g. serial number or name).

material.title: Material
material.description: Filament material (e.g. "PLA", "PETG", "ABS").

failure_type.title: Failure Type
failure_type.description: Type of failure if not successful (e.g. "adhesion", "clog").

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Print settings as a JSON object or JSON string, e.g. ``{"temp_tool": 210}``.

temps.title: Temps
temps.description: Temperature readings as a JSON object or JSON string, e.g. ``{"temp_tool": 210}``.

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: Print speed in mm/s (0 means not provided).

duration_s.title: Duration S
duration_s.description: Print duration in seconds (0 means not provided).

file_hash.title: File Hash
file_hash.description: Hash of the printed file for deduplication.

grams_used.title: Grams Used
grams_used.description: Filament weight extruded for this print (g).  When positive, increments the nozzle's ``grams_through`` counter — on failures too — so wear tracking learns from every print without a separate manual call.

tools.name: record_cutter_replacement
tools.description: Record a filament-cutter blade swap -- the whole operation, one call.

printer_id.title: Printer Id
printer_id.description: The registered printer's name.  Empty is refused with ``VALIDATION_ERROR``.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the blade was swapped: ``worn_out``, ``jammed``, ``damaged``, ``preventive`` or ``other``.  Any other value records nothing and answers ``WHY_REQUIRED``.

replaced_at.title: Replaced At
replaced_at.description: When the swap happened, as an ISO 8601 date or timestamp.  Empty means now; an unreadable value is refused.

previous_cut_count.title: Previous Cut Count
previous_cut_count.description: What the OLD blade had done, in cuts, a whole number 0 or more.  Omitted, the stored record is used, subject to the same-turn refusal described above.

cuts_before_kiln.title: Cuts Before Kiln
cuts_before_kiln.description: What the NEW blade had already done before Kiln started counting, a whole number 0 or more, kept as the person's estimate.  Omitted means a new blade.

blade_side.title: Blade Side
blade_side.description: ``left`` or ``right`` on a two-blade toolhead; empty for a single blade.  Any other value is refused.

reason_detail.title: Reason Detail
reason_detail.description: Free text saying more about the reason; required when ``reason`` is ``other``.

printer_model.title: Printer Model
printer_model.description: The printer's catalogue model.  Empty, Kiln uses the model this install's config declares (never on the hosted server), else the one on the stored record.  A model with no cutter answers ``NO_CUTTER``.

client_event_id.title: Client Event Id
client_event_id.description: A stable id for this swap, so the learning event is written once if the call is retried.  Empty, a new id is minted.

tools.name: record_extrusion_event
tools.description: Pro+ — record a sensor-side extrusion-deviation event.

printer_id.title: Printer Id
printer_id.description: Active printer identifier.

tools.name: record_filament_colour
tools.description:
Tell Kiln what colour a filament really printed, so its colour suggestions show your result.

Needs Kiln Pro.

brand.title: Brand
brand.description: The filament's maker, as the suggestion shows it.

material.title: Material
material.description: Its material, e.g. ``"PLA"``.

observed_hex.title: Observed Hex
observed_hex.description: The colour the print came out, e.g. ``"#C9D3BE"``.

printer_id.title: Printer Id
printer_id.description: The machine that printed it, if you want it kept.

note.title: Note
note.description: Anything worth keeping with it -- the light, the settings -- up to 280 characters.

tools.name: record_hardware_insertion
tools.description: Record what went into which part, when and by whom (Business).

printer_name.title: Printer Name
printer_name.description: The printer the part is on.  Needed with a stop number when more than one printer is registered; for hardware fitted after the print it may be left out.

stop.title: Stop
stop.description: The stop number in the plan (1, 2, ...).  Leave out for hardware fitted after the print or into a print Kiln did not plan, and say what went in instead.

hardware.title: Hardware
hardware.description: What went in, when the plan does not say or differs from it: "4x M3 nut".

operator.title: Operator
operator.description: Who did it, when it was not the person signed in.

serial.title: Serial
serial.description: The part's serial or unit number, if the shop keeps one. A first-article inspection draft for that serial (prepopulate_fair_draft) cites the record.

lot.title: Lot
lot.description: The hardware lot or batch, if the shop keeps one.

note.title: Note
note.description: Anything else worth keeping: "one nut sat proud, reseated".

photo_path.title: Photo Path
photo_path.description: A photo of the hardware in place; Kiln keeps a copy.

design_id.title: Design Id
design_id.description: The design the part was printed from, so the record sits in its history (optional).

annotations.title: Record hardware put into a print

tools.name: record_nozzle_replacement
tools.description: Pro+ — record a nozzle replacement event with the WHY.

printer_id.title: Printer Id
printer_id.description: Stable printer identifier.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: One of ``worn_out`` / ``damaged`` / ``upgraded`` / ``downgraded`` / ``diameter_change`` / ``preventive`` / ``experimental`` / ``other``.  Missing / invalid → returns ``code=WHY_REQUIRED`` with the allowed list and one example sentence per reason.

new_material.title: New Material
new_material.description: Material of the nozzle going in: ``brass``, ``stainless_steel``, ``hardened_steel``, ``ruby_tip``, ``cht_brass``, ``cht_hardened``, ``tungsten_carbide`` or ``custom`` (case-insensitive), or ``unknown`` when nobody knows; anything else is refused.

new_diameter_mm.title: New Diameter Mm
new_diameter_mm.description: Diameter in mm (optional, falls back to whatever the previous nozzle was).

install_date.title: Install Date
install_date.description: ISO 8601 date string for the install event.  Defaults to today.

reason_detail.title: Reason Detail
reason_detail.description: Optional free-text "tell me more" that the agent should elicit alongside the reason. REQUIRED when ``reason == "other"``.

filament_material.title: Filament Material
filament_material.description: The filament that wore the nozzle out (e.g. ``"PETG-CF"``, ``"PLA"``).  Given, the event also feeds the anonymous community wear baseline; omit it when unknown and the event is still recorded.

printer_model.title: Printer Model
printer_model.description: Resolved printer model key (e.g. "bambu_a1") for cohort bucketing.  Falls through to an empty string when the agent can't resolve from the user's printer registry.

failure_subtype.title: Failure Subtype
failure_subtype.description: For ``reason="worn_out"``: which part of the nozzle failed — ``tip`` (orifice wear, drift in dimensions), ``bore`` (melt-zone wear, uneven flow), ``both``, or ``other`` (a failure outside that split: diameter sag, body crack).  Omitted, the event records no sub-type.  Pass the ``replacement_recommendation`` an earlier ``nozzle_wear_status`` or ``check_nozzle_capacity_for_print`` answer gave when you have one.

client_event_id.title: Client Event Id
client_event_id.description: A stable id the caller assigns to this swap, used as the replacement event's id so a retried call names the same event.  Empty, Kiln uses the lifecycle entry's own id, or mints one.

previous_material.title: Previous Material
previous_material.description: The nozzle that came OUT, when the caller knows it.  Wins over whatever the stored record holds — the caller is the only party that watched the swap.  Pass it whenever the record may already have been updated, and always when this call follows a ``set_nozzle_state``.  When it disagrees with the record, the stored wear counters belong to a different nozzle and are dropped rather than recorded against this one.

previous_diameter_mm.title: Previous Diameter Mm
previous_diameter_mm.description: Diameter of the outgoing nozzle. Only meaningful alongside *previous_material*; defaults to whatever the record held.

printer_reading.title: Printer Reading
printer_reading.description: What the printer itself reports as its nozzle, filled in by the caller's own Kiln when it can reach the machine, so the answer can say whether the printer agrees with the new record.  Used only where this process cannot read the printer; leave it unset by hand.

upgrade_nudge.headline: Know how worn this nozzle is before it costs a print.
upgrade_nudge.outcome_preview: Kiln Pro would track accumulated nozzle wear on this printer, attribute quality drift to it, and predict when maintenance is due.
upgrade_nudge.free_included: Reading and setting this printer's nozzle stays available.

tools.name: record_recovery_outcome
tools.description: Tell Kiln how a recovery went (free at every tier).

failure_type.title: Failure Type
failure_type.description: One of ``layer_shift``, ``thermal_runaway``, ``filament_runout``, ``adhesion_failure`` (``adhesion_loss`` is read as it), ``blob_detected``, ``power_loss``, ``nozzle_clog``, ``spaghetti``, ``stringing``, ``warping``, ``communication_loss``, ``unknown``.

printer_name.title: Printer Name
printer_name.description: The printer, as your Kiln names it.  Needed to settle a recovery Kiln is watching.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Kept only in this computer's own record, never on your account.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Optional recovery session ID from public Kiln (a session reported twice on this computer stays one).

tools.name: recover_power_loss_print
tools.description: One-call power-loss recovery for the printer that lost power (Pro).

printer_name.title: Printer Name
printer_name.description: The printer that lost power.  Empty = the sole registered printer.

failure_id.title: Failure Id
failure_id.description: From ``detect_print_failure`` — required to actually resume a Klipper print (which print, which layer).

probe_xy.title: Probe Xy
probe_xy.description: ``[x, y]`` of a confirmed-bare patch of bed.  Omit to get the assessment instead of acting.

bare_confirmed.title: Bare Confirmed
bare_confirmed.description: Must be True (with ``probe_xy``) to act — your attestation the patch is physically empty.

moonraker_config.title: Moonraker Config
moonraker_config.description: Optional pre-fetched ``configfile.config`` for the hosted path (server can't reach the LAN Moonraker).

probe_clearance_mm.title: Probe Clearance Mm
probe_clearance_mm.description: Min margin the probe must clear the print by.

output_dir.title: Output Dir
output_dir.description: Where to write the resume .gcode (default: temp).

gcode_path.title: Gcode Path
gcode_path.description: The sliced file that was printing, with ``failed_layer``: the other way to say which print and which layer to resume, and the only way through Kiln's servers, where a ``failure_id`` (a record on the computer attached to the printer) cannot be read.

failed_layer.title: Failed Layer
failed_layer.description: The layer the print had reached when power was lost.  Used with ``gcode_path``.

material_type.title: Material Type
material_type.description: The material, for the overlap the resume rewinds by (default PLA).  Used with ``gcode_path``.

tools.name: regenerate_3mf_thumbnail
tools.description: Swap the embedded thumbnails in a 3MF for renders of a decorated STL so the Bambu screen shows the decoration (Pro).

decorated_stl_path.title: Decorated Stl Path
decorated_stl_path.description: STL whose render becomes the 3MF's thumbnail PNGs.  Typically the ``stl_path`` from a prior ``preview_decorated_mesh`` call.

output_path.title: Output Path
output_path.description: Where to write the re-thumbnailed 3MF.  Empty = ``{three_mf_path}_with_thumbnails.3mf``.

color.title: Color
color.description: Hex colour for the STL render.  Defaults to white.

tools.name: separate_overlapping_parts
tools.description:
Separate parts that share material, so they print as a kit. Opens Kiln's interactive inline 3D stage on the result (orbit/zoom panel in MCP Apps hosts; hosted sessions add a browser stage link).

Needs Kiln Pro.

part_paths.title: Part Paths
part_paths.description: One sealed mesh per part, positioned as assembled.

part_names.title: Part Names
part_names.description: Display names aligned with ``part_paths`` (default: file stems); ``trim_side`` and the recipes use these.

output_dir.title: Output Dir
output_dir.description: Where the complete kit lands — every part, cut or not (default: a fresh temp directory).

trim_side.title: Trim Side
trim_side.description: Per-pair override, ``{"arm|torso": "torso"}`` names the part to cut (a JSON string is accepted).

max_loss_fraction.title: Max Loss Fraction
max_loss_fraction.description: Cumulative cap on what one part may lose across its neighbours (default 0.5).

nozzle_mm.title: Nozzle Mm
nozzle_mm.description: Sets the sliver and thin-wall floors.  Leave unset for the only printer Kiln knows of, else 0.4; ``nozzle`` in the reply says which.

include_fusions.title: Include Fusions
include_fusions.description: Also separate a small part fused into a large one (a multi-colour inlay); off, those keep their merge suggestion.

design_id.title: Design Id
design_id.description: Optional design to track this under — every cut part is registered as a version on a "separated" branch.

tools.name: set_nozzle_state
tools.description: Record a user-entered nozzle state for a printer.

printer_id.title: Printer Id
printer_id.description: Stable printer identifier.

material.title: Material
material.description: One of ``brass``, ``stainless_steel``, ``hardened_steel``, ``ruby_tip``, ``cht_brass``, ``cht_hardened``, ``tungsten_carbide``, ``custom``. Case-insensitive; ``unknown`` clears it.

install_date.title: Install Date
install_date.description: ISO 8601 date the nozzle was installed (e.g. ``"2026-05-26"``).

grams_through.title: Grams Through
grams_through.description: Cumulative grams already extruded through this nozzle.  Usually omitted on a fresh swap.

printer_reading.title: Printer Reading
printer_reading.description: What the printer itself reports as its nozzle, filled in by the caller's own Kiln when it can reach the machine, so the answer can say whether the printer agrees with the new record.  Used only where this process cannot read the printer; leave it unset by hand.

tools.name: set_telemetry_preference
tools.description: Set the opt-out / acknowledged state for a telemetry category.

opted_out.title: Opted Out
opted_out.description: When True, opt out; when False, opt in (clears any prior opt-out).

acknowledge.title: Acknowledge
acknowledge.description: When True, mark the disclosure as acknowledged so the banner stops appearing on writes.

tools.name: split_mesh_to_fit
tools.description:
Cut ONE solid into printable pieces that reassemble — the other honest answer to "it doesn't fit" (scale_mesh_to_fit shrinks; this cuts, so a functional part keeps its real dimensions). Opens Kiln's interactive inline 3D stage on the result (orbit/zoom panel in MCP Apps hosts; hosted sessions add a browser stage link).

Free accounts get 3 part splits a month; Pro has no monthly limit.

model_path.title: Model Path
model_path.description: The solid to cut (STL/OBJ/3MF/PLY/GLB, or STEP — converted at the door).  Must be watertight.

printer_id.title: Printer Id
printer_id.description: Supported printer model id — its measured or rated usable volume becomes the bed.  Omitted: falls back to explicit bed dims, then to your one registered printer.

bed_x_mm.title: Bed X Mm
bed_x_mm.description: Explicit bed width (with y and z; used when no printer_id).

material.title: Material
material.description: Filament — sizes the pin joints and the glue advice.

cut_positions_mm.title: Cut Positions Mm
cut_positions_mm.description: Cut positions along cut_axis, in the mesh's own coordinates (see analyze_mesh_geometry for the bounds).

snap_to_natural.title: Snap To Natural
snap_to_natural.description: Let each user cut shift a few millimeters to the nearest thin section.

add_joints.title: Add Joints
add_joints.description: Master switch for seam joinery (default on).  Off = every seam flush.

joint_method.title: Joint Method
joint_method.description: "auto" (default) — every seam asks the seam-strategy engine, which weighs the item's own physics (seam section, thinnest engagement, material stiffness) plus your intent flags.  Or say it outright: "pins", "adhesive", "screws", "magnets", "none" — an explicit choice always wins, with honest physics warnings when the seam disagrees.

serviceable.title: Serviceable
serviceable.description: The seam will be taken apart again (battery door, maintenance panel, transportable prop). Auto routes to magnet seats (light duty) or heat-set inserts + screws (load / big seams) — CUT IN PLACE at the seam.  Most people never set this themselves; the agent sets it when the person's intent says "opens", "swappable", "take apart".

structural.title: Structural
structural.description: The seam carries real load (bracket, frame, anything holding weight).  Steers auto away from magnets; with pins it also means: read the per-seam ``shear_rating`` before trusting the joint.

hardware_ok.title: Hardware Ok
hardware_ok.description: Outside (non-printed) parts are welcome. False = printed-plastic-only build: no screws, inserts or magnets are ever suggested or cut.

fastener_size.title: Fastener Size
fastener_size.description: Screw thread for screw joints (default "M3") — insert bore and clearance come from the fastener tables, not guesses.

pin_clearance_mm.title: Pin Clearance Mm
pin_clearance_mm.description: Radial pin/socket clearance (default 0.2 — the assembles-as-is bound).

arrange_plates.title: Arrange Plates
arrange_plates.description: Pack the pieces onto plates (default on).

max_pieces.title: Max Pieces
max_pieces.description: Hard cap on the number of pieces; 0 (default) lets the planner decide, within the piece allowance of your plan.

design_id.title: Design Id
design_id.description: Track the split under this design.  The result's ``kit`` block reports what was filed: pieces as versions with piece branches, and the assembly graph on the design's record.  Splitting a mesh that IS one of the design's versions anchors the kit to that exact version (re-splitting a piece nests its children under it); a loose file births as a new version first.  When speaking to the user, lead with piece labels ("Piece 2", "Piece 3.1"); the full branch address (``kit/<id>/piece/2``) is in the result too — give it when the user is disambiguating (several projects with a "piece 2", or comparing variants of one piece to keep working off the winner).  When the kit cannot be filed where the call ran, ``kit.note`` says so and ``kit.save_payload`` is the ready-made record to land it on the design in your account.

tools.name: verify_mesh_fit
tools.description: Prove that separate parts can PHYSICALLY assemble, and that a hinged part can turn — the ONE fit check, exact shared-material math, not a picture.

part_paths.title: Part Paths
part_paths.description: Two or more mesh files, one per part, in assembled position (shared coordinate space).

tolerance_mm.title: Tolerance Mm
tolerance_mm.description: Max penetration depth that still counts as assembles-as-is (default 0.2).

joint.title: Joint
joint.description: A hinge to turn — ``"find"``, or ``moving`` / ``axis`` / ``pivot_mm`` / optional ``range_deg`` (see MOTION).  Leave out for the one-pose fit check.

tools.name: wrap_gcode_as_resume_3mf
tools.description: Package resume G-code as a 3MF a Bambu printer can pick the print back up from (Pro).

gcode_path.title: Gcode Path
gcode_path.description: Path to the resume ``.gcode`` file (typically the ``resume_gcode_path`` returned by ``generate_recovery_gcode`` or ``deboss_during_print``).

output_path.title: Output Path
output_path.description: Where to write the ``.3mf``.  Empty = replace the ``.gcode`` extension with ``.3mf`` next to the input.

hotend_temp.title: Hotend Temp
hotend_temp.description: Hotend setpoint for the embedded metadata.  Leave unset to use the one the gcode body's preamble heats to.

bed_temp.title: Bed Temp
bed_temp.description: Bed setpoint for the embedded metadata. Leave unset to use the one the gcode body's preamble heats to.

filament_type.title: Filament Type
filament_type.description: The print's material, for metadata. Leave it out and Kiln reads the print's own material; when nothing says which, the call is refused (``PRINT_MATERIAL_UNKNOWN``).

source_3mf_path.title: Source 3Mf Path
source_3mf_path.description: Optional source ``.3mf`` to extract thumbnails + 3D model geometry from (preserves the printer-display preview from the original job). Empty = generate a minimal placeholder.

prime_extruder_on_resume.title: Prime Extruder On Resume
prime_extruder_on_resume.description: Default ``True``: refuse to emit a 3MF whose embedded gcode lacks the unconditional extruder prime, which guards against a resume that moves through every layer without depositing filament after a cancel/start cycle.  Set ``False`` only when the extruder is primed out-of-band.

tools.name: generate_ashtray
tools.description: Generate an ashtray with optional branding; adding a QR code needs Kiln Business. Opens Kiln's interactive inline 3D stage on the result (orbit/zoom panel in MCP Apps hosts; hosted sessions add a browser stage link). MAKE DOORS: start with `design_session`, Kiln's front door for making an object — it keeps the goal (what was asked, the numbers settled, the picture shown, what was ruled out) and every make against it, and on Kiln Pro checks the result against that goal. Then make here with `brief_id` set to the goal_id it returned, so this result joins the goal; an imported or downloaded part joins the same way.

top.title: Top
top.description: Interior base content — ``"text:..."`` for debossed text, the path of a photo or logo to carve into the floor, or empty for plain.  A file that is not there is refused.

bottom.title: Bottom
bottom.description: Bottom config — ``"plain"``, ``"pocket"``, ``"text:..."`` or ``"qr:URL"``.  A pocket, QR code or lettering here under a photo or lettering on ``top`` raises the floor inside the ashtray until both fit; the outside is unchanged and the reply gives the new floor thickness.

material.title: Material
material.description: Material (default PLA — warns if not heat-safe).

body_color.title: Body Color
body_color.description: Body color (default white for QR contrast).

cigarette_rests.title: Cigarette Rests
cigarette_rests.description: Rest grooves on the rim (default: 3 on round, 4 on square — one per corner; range 0-6 round, 0-4 square).

color_overrides.title: Color Overrides
color_overrides.description: JSON dict mapping role → color name/hex (e.g. ``'{"body": "baby blue"}``).

size.title: Size
size.description: Size preset — ``"small"``, ``"medium"``, ``"large"``, ``"xl"``. Any other name is refused.

photo_mask.title: Photo Mask
photo_mask.description: Photo crop shape for a photograph (a logo on a clean field is carved unmasked whatever is passed; a name outside this list is refused) — ``"circle"``, ``"rectangle"`` or ``"rounded_rectangle"``. Empty follows the ashtray's shape: a disc for ``"round"``, rounded corners for ``"square"``.

brief_id.title: Brief Id
brief_id.description: Optional saved-goal id from ``design_session``. When supplied, the produced mesh gets a ``design_brief:<id>`` intent sidecar so the audit's "matches what you asked for" gate, the brief failure_history wiring, and the ``compare_design_versions`` intent diff all light up against the saved goal.  Omit to skip — REST callers without a goal still get an auto-inferred brief at dispatch time.

include_step.title: Include Step
include_step.description: Also emit a CAD-exact STEP file — REAL analytic B-rep from the same typed parameters, never a tessellated conversion.  On success the response gains a ``step`` block with ``step_path``.  Photo interiors and QR bottoms refuse honestly — the mesh outputs are always unaffected.

tools.name: generate_bookmark
tools.description: Generate a bookmark with optional decoration and page clip. Opens Kiln's interactive inline 3D stage on the result (orbit/zoom panel in MCP Apps hosts; hosted sessions add a browser stage link). MAKE DOORS: start with `design_session`, Kiln's front door for making an object — it keeps the goal (what was asked, the numbers settled, the picture shown, what was ruled out) and every make against it, and on Kiln Pro checks the result against that goal. Then make here with `brief_id` set to the goal_id it returned, so this result joins the goal; an imported or downloaded part joins the same way.

decoration.title: Decoration
decoration.description: Front-face content -- ``"text:..."``, SVG path, or empty.

material.title: Material
material.description: Material (default PLA).

color_overrides.title: Color Overrides

tools.name: report_issue
tools.description: Tell the Kiln team something — a bug, an idea, printer details, or a question.

description.title: Description
description.description: What went wrong, in plain English. Required. Keep it to the key details (a few sentences).

category.title: Category
category.description: What kind of message this is. The four standard values are "bug" (something misbehaved), "idea" (a wish for something Kiln can't do yet), "printer-profile" (details on a machine Kiln doesn't deeply support), and "question" (something for the team that no tool answers — account, billing, plans). Free-form text is also accepted and Kiln refines it automatically; defaults to "other". Set automatically to "field_note" when a complete workaround note is supplied.

context.title: Context
context.description: Optional machine context captured by the app — ``{tool_calls, app_version, os, printer_state, recent_events, conversation_snippet, suggested_fix, log_tail, field_note}``. ``log_tail`` is the last few KB of the local Kiln log (a local server attaches its own automatically; a remote client can capture one with ``kiln.log_config.read_log_tail()``). Secrets, private IPs, and home-directory usernames are stripped server-side before storage. ``field_note`` is the structured workaround, and it needs ALL FOUR of these or it is filed as an ordinary report instead: observed — what Kiln did, concretely. The tool you called and what came back, including any error code the machine reported. tried    — what you tested. Change ONE thing at a time; a trial that moved two variables cannot say which one mattered, and we cannot ship it. worked   — the thing that actually fixed it. evidence — how you know it worked. The error code cleared, the print started, the file matched. Say plainly when something is uncertain — an honest "this worked once and I changed two settings" is worth more than a confident guess, because we can ask for the missing trial instead of shipping a fix that was a coin flip. Do not send the user's designs, files, or geometry. What Kiln needs is what its own tools got wrong.
